verdict.rationale: Bank feed automation is well documented (auto-import, categorization, reconciliation APIs) and general integration breadth (500+ apps, MCP) is claimed, but there is no explicit evidence of dedicated payments-gateway or payroll-system integrations feeding the ledger. Missing for 10: explicit payroll system connectors (e.g., Zoho Payroll or Gusto), explicit payment processor integrations (Stripe/PayPal) beyond generic '500+ integrations' claim, and independent confirmation these flows work end-to-end.
